name: Dhikr Pavilion
summary: An open mosque pavilion holds a circular strand of prayer beads, with its tail passing through the entrance.
why: The shallow domed hall joins a wider sculpted minaret in one uninterrupted outline. Eight rounded beads follow an exact circular cord. The loop and its hanging tail share the x58 entrance axis; the doorway remains open around the strand.
risk: The beads become a simple ring at 24 pixels. The larger preview reveals the individual beads and hanging tail most clearly.
reasonToChoose: You want prayer and remembrance to share the same architectural mark.
